info.name: SMemories - templates and print feedback
info.description: Template list, the template choice on a yearbook and the anonymous print-feedback counter (T-061, epic E05). Run against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev and a migrated database (the counter table). Each run registers 2 users (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP: run `make reset-limits` before a third run within the hour) and sends 3 accepted feedback answers (the per-IP limit is 30 per hour; its 429 is covered by the Go tests, not here, to keep the run short). Run the whole collection in order: the Edge cases folder reuses the users and the books of the Full flow.

item.name: Full flow

exec: // Folder scripts run before every request in the folder, so generate only before the first one: the whole flow then
// uses one consistent pair of accounts, and every new run gets fresh ones.

item.name: 1. Register user A
2. Register user B
3. A creates an A5 yearbook
4. A lists all templates

exec: pm.test('every template is complete', () => d.items.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(i.name.en).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(i.name.vi).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(i.page_sizes).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(i.renderer).to.be.oneOf(['html', 'go']); pm.expect(i.preview).to.eql('/template-previews/' + i.id + '.jpg'); }));
pm.test('memory-book is an html template', () => pm.expect(d.items.find(i => i.id === 'memory-book').renderer).to.eql('html'));

item.name: 5. A lists the templates for A5
6. A lists the templates for Letter: memory-book yes, classic no
7. A picks memory-book
8. A reads the book back: the choice is kept
9. A changes the page size to Letter (memory-book supports it)

exec: pm.test('size changed, template kept', () => { const b = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(b.page_size).to.eql('Letter'); pm.expect(b.template_id).to.eql('memory-book'); });

item.name: 10. A picks classic for the Letter book - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE (no Letter)
11. The refused choice changed nothing

exec: pm.test('still memory-book on Letter', () => { const b = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(b.template_id).to.eql('memory-book'); pm.expect(b.page_size).to.eql('Letter'); });

item.name: 12. B cannot set a template on A's book - 404
13. A clears the template with null
14. A creates a book with classic on A4 (create takes template_id too)
15. A changes that book's size to Letter - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE (classic has no Letter)
16. A changes the size and clears the template together - 200

exec: pm.test('both applied', () => { const b = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(b.page_size).to.eql('Letter'); pm.expect(b.template_id).to.eql(null); });

item.name: 17. Print feedback without a session: yes for Chrome or Edge

exec: pm.test('empty data', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(j.data).to.eql({}); });

item.name: 18. Print feedback without a session: no for iOS Safari
Edge cases
Template list without a session - 401
Template list - page size A3 - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Template list - page size a5 (wrong case) - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Template list - empty page_size means all - 200
Template list is GET only (POST) - 405
Update - unknown template - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Update - empty template id - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Update - template id over 32 characters (boundary) - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Update - template id with another case (Memory-Book) - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Update - template id is a number - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Update - template id as an object - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Update - template without a session - 401
Update - template with a session cookie from a foreign Origin - 403
Create - unknown template - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Create - Letter with classic - 400 ERROR_INVALID_TEMPLATE
Feedback - unknown verdict - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - verdict in another case (YES) - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - unknown browser family - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - a whole user agent string as the family - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - missing browser_family - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - empty object - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - extra field (user_agent) - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - extra field (count) - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - verdict is a number - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Feedback - malformed JSON - 400
Feedback - body that is an array - 400
Feedback - text/plain body - 415
Feedback - session cookie from a foreign Origin - 403
Feedback - session cookie from the app's own Origin - 200
Feedback - GET is not allowed - 405
